_comments.setup: Edit interfaces and serials below for your physical rig. Bare uv run spill loads config/local.json from the current directory. This local file is Git-ignored; config/pill-transfer.example.json is the committed template.
_comments.interfaces.left: Linux SocketCAN interface connected to the LEFT arm; this cell uses can_left.
_comments.interfaces.right: Linux SocketCAN interface connected to the RIGHT arm; this cell uses can_right. The two arms must use distinct interfaces.
_comments.serials.top: ASIC serial of the overhead RealSense D435. Keep serial numbers as quoted strings; Karma resolves ASIC serials to camera devices.
_comments.serials.left_wrist: ASIC serial of the RealSense D405 mounted on the LEFT wrist, not the left side of an image.
_comments.serials.right_wrist: ASIC serial of the RealSense D405 mounted on the RIGHT wrist. All three camera serials must be distinct.
_comments.dream.checkpoint: Default Dream-only model: dreamlabs/dream-1-beta. Model access is checked with your account; no silent checkpoint substitution.
_comments.credentials: Set DREAM_API_KEY in your shell or use uv run --env-file .env spill. Do not store API keys here. OPENAI_API_KEY is only needed for Astra modes.
_comments.calibration: Bare uv run spill uses zero-shot mode and skips measured geometric collision checks. A calibration template is not a measured calibration.
